setup_intro: Welcome. This page sets up your Aquarium in about 5 minutes. The link works once and expires {expiry}.
s1_d: You are the owner: the one person who can change everything. Use your work email.
pw_hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence you can remember works well, e.g. “Blue tram to Central at 8”.
s2_d: Each sign-in also asks for a 6-digit code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…). This stops someone who has learned your password.
s2_later: You can also skip this and turn it on later in Settings → Get ready.
s3_d: Aquarium needs an account with an AI model provider. Paste the API key from the provider's website.
findkey: Where do I find my key?
s3_testing: Sending one short message to the model…
s3_ok: ✓ Works. The model replied in {seconds} s.
s3_model: Chats use the recommended model for this provider. You can change it later in Models.
tz_note: Picked from this browser. Used for reminders, schedules and dates in messages.
lang_note: Changes this page right away. Each person can choose their own language later.
s5_d: Aquarium is using a temporary address now. If you own a domain name, point it at this server and check it here.
s5_r1: ✓ The name points to this server
s5_next: After you finish, open https://{host} and sign in there.
s5_how: How to point a domain: at your domain provider, add an “A record” for this name with the server's address {address}.
finish_note: Next you'll see the Get ready checklist.
s3_key_bad: ✗ The provider says this key is not valid. Check you copied all of it.
s3_test_bad: ✗ The key was accepted but the model did not reply. Nothing was saved. Try again, or try another provider.
s3_skip: You can also skip this and add the key later in Settings → Get ready.
s2_later_only: Set up 2-factor later in Get ready. After you finish, open Settings → Get ready → Owner account and turn it on there.
s5_how_noaddr: How to point a domain: at your domain provider, add an “A record” for this name with this server's public address.
s5_bad_name: ✗ This name does not point to this server yet. DNS changes can take up to an hour.
s5_no_name: ✗ This name was not found. Check the spelling, or add the record at your domain provider.
s5_no_https: ! The name points here, but the secure connection (HTTPS) is not ready yet. It usually starts working a few minutes after the name points here.
invalid_1: This setup link is not valid. It may have expired (links last 24 hours) or been used already.
invalid_2: To get a new one, run “hermes setup-link” on the server (as the Aquarium service account). A new link cancels the old one.
err_network: Aquarium could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
err_signin: Your account is ready, but signing in failed. Sign in with your email and password.
reset_intro: This link sets a new password for the owner's login.
